title: Palm Hill Ukulele Group Gathering
summary: Good day Palm Hill Country Club! The Palm Hill Ukulele Group would like to invite you to their gathering this Wednesday June 10th. @ the South's Club House for their pickin and grinnin session. They will be gathering @ 3:00 P.M. and hope to get in about an hour of playin! Bring your voice, bring your ukulele, bring a friend to the gathering, they would love to see you there. Have a great day!
